versions.changelog:
**v1.1.0 is a major update focused on answer quality and reliability.**

- Adds prompt recipes (`--recipe finance|tech|research`) to systematically wrap questions in validated instructions for better Perplexity responses; details in `references/perplexity-playbook.md`.
- Adds output `site_checks`: detects silent model downgrades (`model_label`) and flags decorative/unsupported citations in answers.
- Enhances CLI with `--recipe` and improved `--text` defaults (now wraps with recipe unless default selected).
- Documents new anti-pitfall rules; improves README and SKILL.md with clear guidance.
- Passes 70 new tests for prompt recipes and output checks; removes obsolete `skill-card.md`.
